query:
SELECT source_id,ra,dec,parallax,parallax_error,pm,ruwe,bp_rp,phot_g_mean_mag
FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source
WHERE pm > 35
AND bp_rp < 1.2
AND parallax_over_error > 3
AND 4.74047 * pm > 1000 * parallax
AND phot_g_mean_mag + 5 * LOG10(parallax) - 10 > 3.5
